name: InterStim FI pivotal study
question: Among patients with fecal incontinence who respond to test stimulation, how often does InterStim implantation reduce weekly incontinence episodes by at least half?

design.population: Patients with fecal incontinence who had at least 50% improvement during test stimulation and received chronic InterStim implantation.
design.description: Prospective multicenter single-arm study after test stimulation
design.locator: Wexner 2010, PubMed abstract, Methods and Results

verdictNote: The prespecified 50% responder threshold was exceeded in implanted patients at 12 months.
takeaway: In a prospective single-arm study, 83% of implanted patients assessed at 12 months after InterStim sacral nerve stimulation had at least 50% fewer weekly fecal incontinence episodes, exceeding the prespecified 50% responder threshold.

reports.label: 12-month pivotal report
reports.dateLocator: Crossref and PubMed give March 2010 issue; exact online publication date not verified
reports.citation: Wexner SD, Coller JA, Devroede G, et al. "Sacral Nerve Stimulation for Fecal Incontinence: Results of a 120-Patient Prospective Multicenter Study." *Ann Surg.* 2010;251(3):441-449. doi:10.1097/SLA.0b013e3181cf8ed0
reports.followUp: Mean 28 months (range 2.2-69.5 months); primary endpoint at 12 months

results.measure: At least 50% reduction in weekly incontinent episodes at 12 months versus baseline
results.note: Prespecified objective: at least 50% of implanted subjects achieve therapeutic success; abstract does not give the 12-month analysis denominator.
The abstract does not give an analysis denominator.

results.measure: Mean episodes per week at baseline and 12 months
At least 50% reduction in weekly incontinent episodes at 24 months
results.note: The abstract does not give an analysis denominator.

harms.label: Unanticipated adverse device effects
harms.note: The abstract does not enumerate anticipated adverse events.

delivery.label: Test stimulation and implantation
delivery.value: 133 underwent test stimulation; 120 received chronic InterStim implantation after at least 50% improvement during testing (90% test success reported).

reports.label: 3-year follow-up
reports.dateLocator: Crossref and PubMed give September 2011 issue; exact online publication date not verified

reports.followUp: Mean 3.1 years (range 0.2-6.1 years); 83 completed all or part of 3-year assessment

results.measure: At least 50% reduction in weekly incontinent episodes at 3 years
results.note: Among patients assessed at 3 years; the abstract does not give a result-specific denominator.
The abstract does not give an analysis denominator.

values.snm: Implant-site pain 28%; paresthesia 15%; altered sensation of stimulation 12%; infection 10%

harms.note: Among 76 patients followed at least 5 years.

delivery.value: 76/120 implanted patients (63%) were followed at least 5 years; 72 had evaluable episode diaries.

delivery.label: Test stimulation
delivery.value: A 14-day test stimulation period preceded permanent implantation after at least 50% improvement in weekly episodes.
